title: How To Edit The SEO Elements Of An Individual Member Profile Page | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How To Edit The SEO Elements Of An Individual Member Profile Page Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000682652 Steps Log in to the Admin Area . Navigate to My Members > Search Members . Locate the member profile to update. Hover over the Actions menu for that member, then click Quick Edit . Click the Advanced Options tab. Scroll down until the SEO options become visible. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
